description: This file contains unit tests for the ModifyThingStrategy class, which is likely responsible for applying modifications to 'Thing' objects within the persistence layer of the Eclipse Ditto framework. The tests verify immutability and modify existing 'Thing' instances, ensuring correct behavior in the modification strategy.

classes.name: ModifyThingStrategyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the ModifyThingStrategy's behavior, including immutability and modification logic.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that the ModifyThingStrategy class is immutable.

methods.name: modifyExisting
methods.description: Tests the modification of an existing 'Thing' object, ensuring the ModifyThingStrategy correctly applies the modifications and produces a ThingModified event.

calls: assertModificationResult(underTest, existing, modifyThing, ThingModified.class, modifyThingResponse(existing, thing, modifyThing.getDittoHeaders(), false))
